{{Quote|Worse than a grenade... A ''flash-bomb''! I'm ''blind''!|[[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]]|<ref name="BJB">{{TCWComicCite|6.29|Blind Jedi's Bluff}}</ref>}}
A '''flash grenade''', also known as a '''flash-bang grenade''' or '''flash bomb''', was a weapon that, when thrown, blinded and deafened the target rather than harming them, allowing the user to either attack or flee. Most modern versions disrupted the senses of both organic and inorganics such as [[Droid/Legends|droids]]. [[Clone commando/Legends|Clone commandos]] used these weapons to great advantage during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Behind the scenes==
This grenade should not be confused with the various types of [[Concussion grenade/Legends|concussion grenade]].
